gloss_hint: This means bending the world to one's will with skill and nerve: a sure hand with every tool, a ready tongue, and the knack of making happen whatever one sets out to do.
This means delighting in the senses and in plenty: savoring food, touch, beauty and growing things, abundant and generous, and bringing comfort and pleasure wherever one settles.
This means living for love: drawn to beauty and to one other person, choosing by the heart, and binding one's life and one's values to the one one loves.
This means driving on to victory by force of will: mastering opposing pulls, pressing through every trial, and taking pride in each conquest.
This means letting go of control willingly: ceasing to struggle, waiting in suspension, seeing the world from a reversed angle, and finding insight through sacrifice.
This means letting old ways and old selves end, answering an inner call to begin again, taking honest stock of one's life, and being reborn to a new purpose.
This means keeping hope after the storm: serene and open-hearted, trusting in a brighter future, and pouring out what one has to renew others.
This means living in the half-light of imagination: drifting in daydreams, uneasy and easily deceived, haunted by vague fears, and seeing shapes in the dark that may not be there.
This means stepping into the unknown with a light heart: setting out on a whim, trusting the road to hold, and walking to the cliff's edge without a thought of falling.
